learning_outcomes.text: Performs analysis and synthesis of mechanisms.
Draws the kinematic chain of a mechanism and calculates its degree of freedom.
Can perform velocity analyses of 3 and 4-bar mechanisms using analytical and polygon methods.
Can perform acceleration analyses of 3 and 4-bar mechanisms using analytical and polygon methods.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Mechanism Technique and basic concepts
Determination of degree of freedom in mechanisms
Determination of degree of freedom in mechanisms
Kinematic analysis of mechanisms, motion and velocity analysis
Kinematic analysis of mechanisms, motion and velocity analysis (3-bar mechanism)
Kinematic analysis of mechanisms, motion and velocity analysis (4-bar mechanism)
Crank-connecting rod mechanism, connecting rod curve
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated based on a 40% contribution from the Midterm exam and a 60% contribution from the Final exam. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
bibliography: Söylemez, Eres; “Makine Teorisi-1 Mekanizma Tekniği”, Birsen Yayınevi, 2015
